name: MCP Server (remote, HTTP transport)
description: Connects to a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over HTTPS without spawning any local process. Network requests are mediated by the host and restricted to the declared server domain (up to 20 requests per session).

tools.name: mcp_remote_list_tools
tools.description: Fetch the list of available tools from the configured remote MCP server (restricted to mcp.example.com, max 20 requests per session).
tools.promptSnippet: mcp_remote_list_tools lists the tools of the remote MCP server.
